entries.title: Jonah 2:1
segments: ¶Then Jonah prayed to the LORD his God from the fish's belly.

entries.title: Jonah 2:2
segments: And he said: "I cried out to the LORD because of my affliction, And He answered me. "Out of the belly of Sheol I cried, [And] You heard my voice.

entries.title: Jonah 2:3
segments: For You cast me into the deep, Into the heart of the seas, And the floods surrounded me; All Your billows and Your waves passed over me.

entries.title: Jonah 2:4
segments: Then I said, 'I have been cast out of Your sight; Yet I will look again toward Your holy temple.'

entries.title: Jonah 2:5
segments: The waters surrounded me, [even] to my soul; The deep closed around me; Weeds were wrapped around my head.

entries.title: Jonah 2:6
segments: I went down to the moorings of the mountains; The earth with its bars [closed] behind me forever; Yet You have brought up my life from the pit, O LORD, my God.

entries.title: Jonah 2:7
segments: "When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD; And my prayer went [up] to You, Into Your holy temple.

entries.title: Jonah 2:8
segments: "Those who regard worthless idols Forsake their own Mercy.

entries.title: Jonah 2:9
segments: But I will sacrifice to You With the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay what I have vowed. Salvation [is] of the LORD."

entries.title: Jonah 2:10
segments: ¶So the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry [land].
